sourceNote: Back cover, file 301 (no printed page number): the photograph of the Mahabat Khan Mosque, Peshawar (not reproduced; its caption is given), the National Anthem in a box, the publisher’s logo and name (logo not reproduced) and the printing details. The scan is slightly skewed and tinted. English and Pashto are our translations (need native review); watermark, handwriting and ornamental borders excluded. Printed page = scan − 5 (scans from 30); printed page 24 is absent from the source.
